name: Juukan ACE NO.07 2007 July
source:
Main character Hayate is a dog. He comes across a girl attacked by stray dogs in his travels and rescues her. Girl is so grateful that she agrees to become dog's lover. It's a story of a girl making love with a dog.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-june-2007-koisuru-otome-to.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角疾风是一只狗。他在旅途中遇到了一个被流浪狗袭击的女孩，并救了她。女孩感激不尽，同意成为狗的情人。这是一个女孩和狗做爱的故事。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-june-2007-koisuru-otome-to.html]vndbreview[/url]]
